sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
Celina attacked [[Lok Lambert]] and [[Sophie Casterwill]] while they were looking for books about the city of [[Ys]]. Disguised as a tourist, she followed them and threw knives at the duo. She then pursued the two of them alongside her partner Bonnie and surrounded them. The two overpowered and Sophie but were attacked by [[Dante Vale]] before they could defeat Lok and reported back to an enraged [[Dr. Rickman]]. Later, the pair arrived at the city of [[Ys]] with Rickman and [[Captain Caine]]. {{Source|The Seekers of Ys}}

Celina then attacked Dante, summoning [[Red Vampress]] alongside Bonnie's [[Geisha]]. However they were eventually defeated when [[Zhalia Moon]] arrived and the pair were arrested by the [[Huntik Foundation]] along with [[Dr. Rickman]], [[Gregor]] and [[Ford]]. {{source|The Lost City of Casterwill}}

Celina is a member of the Organization and, along with Bonnie, is a minion of Dr. Rickman.

== History ==
Celina attacked Lok Lambert and Sophie Casterwill while they were looking for books about the city of Ys. Disguised as a tourist, she followed them and threw knives at the duo. She then pursued the two of them alongside her partner Bonnie and surrounded them. The two overpowered and Sophie but were attacked by Dante Vale before they could defeat Lok and reported back to an enraged Dr. Rickman. Later, the pair arrived at the city of Ys with Rickman and Captain Caine. [The Seekers of Ys]

Celina then attacked Dante, summoning Red Vampress alongside Bonnie's Geisha. However they were eventually defeated when Zhalia Moon arrived and the pair were arrested by the Huntik Foundation along with Dr. Rickman, Gregor and Ford. [The Lost City of Casterwill]

== Personality ==
Celina was cruel and sadistic, like Bonnie, attempting to kill Dante Vale with their knives.

== Abilities ==
Celina is adept at throwing knives with great speed and accuracy.

=== Spells Utilized ===
*Knifepoint

=== Bonded Titans ===
*Red Vampress
